synthesis:draft.headline: VIC1 five-minute RRP reached -504.6525 $/MWh at 2026-07-28 21:20 AEST (interval end).
summary: The five-minute Regional Reference Price (RRP) minimum was -504.6525 $/MWh at interval ending 2026-07-28T11:20:00Z (2026-07-28 21:20 AEST).
The extreme negative RRP was part of a short episode spanning 2 five-minute intervals (2026-07-28T11:15:00Z to 2026-07-28T11:25:00Z).
Operational demand for the half-hour containing the price extreme (half-hour ending 2026-07-28T11:30:00Z) was 7,491 MW; the window maximum operational demand observed was 8,131 MW.

AEMO published market notices for the region and window including a non-conformance declaration for unit TRGBESS1, an automated constraint invocation (CA_SYDS_597A8B26) invoked from 11:00 hrs, and a Moorabool No. 2 220 kV Bus trip; those notices are listed under published_findings below.
SCADA-observed generation changes in the 05:30–17:30 UTC window included GPWFWEST with a change of -220.26 MW (descriptive SCADA observation).
A public demand forecast vs actual comparison for the 24 half-hours around the event reports MAE = 186.88 MW.

numeric_claims.text: operational demand in half-hour ending 2026-07-28T11:30:00Z is 7,491 MW

possible_explanations.statement: Net supply exceeded demand for the five-minute interval ending 2026-07-28T11:20:00Z (2026-07-28 21:20 AEST), which may have pushed clearing prices negative.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Check the interval-level offer/dispatch stack and per-unit dispatch MW and offer prices for interval ending 2026-07-28T11:20:00Z (2026-07-28 21:20 AEST) and the market clearing volumes for that five-minute dispatch.

possible_explanations.statement: An automated constraint set (CA_SYDS_597A8B26) was invoked from 11:00 hrs and might have altered interconnector or local security limits in a way that could coincide with negative prices (see citation c2).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Examine the constraint binding flags, LHS/RHS values and interconnector flow (NETINTERCHANGE) for the five-minute intervals around 2026-07-28T11:20:00Z to see if the CA_SYDS equations were binding at that interval.

possible_explanations.statement: Large injections from resources (including batteries or semi-scheduled units) could have coincided with moderate demand and contributed to negative clearing prices; a prior non-conformance declaration for TRGBESS1 is on record (see citation c1).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Retrieve per-unit dispatch and availability (including TRGBESS1) and any rebid/availability logs for the minutes before and including 2026-07-28T11:20:00Z to see injected MW and offer prices.

possible_explanations.statement: Fast bidding changes or rebids close to dispatch might have produced a transient negative price (rebids are not in the current evidence).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Review the rebid log and offers submitted in the minutes immediately before 2026-07-28T11:20:00Z; check whether rebids altered available supply or offer prices into that five-minute dispatch.
